header_desc: The joint flight of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the definitive union between intuition, spirituality, science, and technology, allowing us to answer the fundamental question of who we are in the Universe. Likewise, it offers us a profound explanation of the so-called rapture of the Church by redefining it as a spiritual awakening: matter is an emergent property of our psyche, so the timeless plane of the cosmos is intimately linked to the pneuma, thus revealing that we harbor within us that divine spark ❤️ ✝️.
left_body: The solution to one of the great pillars of modern physics—the quantum gravity—finds its key in texts written almost two millennia ago: the Gnostic gospels. In this plane, consciousness manifests through the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, which reveals that we possess a true free will of perception, mathematically formalized through the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. Space-time tells matter how to move, and matter tells space-time how to curve; thus, possessed by the mass and density of an ego that distorts us, stripping it away equates to freeing ourselves from that earthly gravity to return to the pure light of the Ineffable Father: The One.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there's not much sense in praying to the law of gravity
universe_light_text: The Father and I are one: Remembering who you are—the revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist—frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Trapped in the chaos of the material world—ruled by the ignorance of Yaldabaoth—lies Sophia, the divine wisdom. Our right hemisphere is linked to divine feeling, while the left is linked to material thought.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force of the ego drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken, and all of humanity will heal.
video_title: Documentary From the Material Prison to the Pleroma of Light
